name: Extralio Cart Extras for WooCommerce
author: nivmalka

sections.description:
Extralio Cart Extras is a Blocks-first WooCommerce extension. Merchants create multiple linked Product Extras, choose where and when they appear, control their display order, and attach staff-facing fulfillment information. Shoppers can select or remove an Extra without a page refresh and optionally provide customer text. The server validates every action and adds a real WooCommerce product to the cart.

Version 1.0.0 supports the native WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks only. Classic Cart and Checkout pages that use WooCommerce shortcodes are not supported.

Version 1.0.0 supports Product Extras in the Cart and Checkout blocks, Extra-only product protection, optional or required customer text, one display condition per Extra, display ordering, fulfillment snapshots saved with orders, and an administrative Setup & Status dashboard. Fee and information-only Extras are intentionally outside this release.

The supported display conditions are Always, Cart contains product, Cart contains product category, Cart subtotal is at least, and Cart subtotal is at most.

Privacy and data handling

When a store enables customer text for an Extra, the shopper may enter optional or required text related to that Extra. The text is temporarily stored in the WooCommerce cart and session. When the shopper places an order, it is copied to metadata on the related WooCommerce order item.

Store administrators, staff who can access orders, and relevant recipients of order details may see the text. Extralio Cart Extras for WooCommerce does not transmit customer text or other data to an external service.

Customer-entered Extra text follows the store’s WooCommerce and order-retention practices. The plugin registers with the WordPress personal-data export and erasure tools. Exports include only the related order number, order date, Extra label, customer text field label, and entered text. Erasure removes the internal and customer-visible text copies while retaining the order, product line, prices, fulfillment snapshots, and accounting data. Order text is retained when the store has disabled WooCommerce order-data erasure.
sections.installation:
The Extralio Cart Extras blocks are not inserted automatically.

Cart page

  1. Edit the WooCommerce Cart page.
  2. Add “Extralio Cart Extras – Cart” inside the Cart Totals block.
  3. Save the page.

Checkout page

  1. Edit the WooCommerce Checkout page.
  2. Add “Extralio Cart Extras – Checkout” inside the Checkout Fields block.
  3. Save the page.

Setup checklist

  1. Confirm WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Install and activate Extralio Cart Extras for WooCommerce.
  3. Add both Extralio Cart Extras blocks manually using the steps above.
  4. Create a published, purchasable WooCommerce product for the Extra.
  5. Open WooCommerce > Extralio Cart Extras and create and publish the Extra.
  6. Enable Extra-only product when the linked product should be available only through the Extra.
  7. Run a complete test order.
  8. Verify customer text and fulfillment information on the order.

The Extralio Cart Extras blocks render only when an eligible Extra exists for their location.
sections.faq:
Does this replace my checkout?

No. It extends the native WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks.

Does it support classic Cart and Checkout pages?

No. Version 1.0.0 supports the native WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks. Pages that use the classic WooCommerce cart and checkout shortcodes are not supported.

Is the price trusted from the browser?

No. The browser sends only an Extra ID and action. Product, price, availability, conditions, and cart changes are resolved on the server.

Does it support HPOS?

Yes. Order data is written through WooCommerce CRUD APIs and compatibility is declared.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First stable public release.
  • Added Product Extras to the WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • Added Extra-only product protection, optional or required customer text, display conditions, and display ordering.
  • Added fulfillment snapshots to orders and a Setup & Status dashboard for merchants.
  • Added privacy-policy guidance and WordPress personal-data export and erasure support for customer-entered Extra text.

0.2.1-beta.1

  • Added Extras and Setup & Status admin tabs.
  • Added a setup dashboard for WooCommerce compatibility, configured pages, and required Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • Added direct page-editor actions and accessible block-placement guidance.
  • Preserved the existing Extras editor and all Cart, Checkout, Store API, and order behavior.

0.2.0-beta.1

  • First controlled Beta release.
  • Product Extras displayed in the Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • Extra-only linked product protection across customer-facing discovery surfaces.
  • Optional or required customer text saved with selected Extras.
  • One display condition per Extra, multiple Extras, and priority ordering.
  • Fulfillment labels, instructions, and customer text saved as order snapshots.
  • Improved merchant editor, product summaries, previews, and save-state feedback.

0.1.0

  • Initial product-ready project foundation.
  • Product Extra CRUD and admin screen.
  • Native Store API data and cart mutations.
  • Cart and Checkout inner blocks.
  • Real product line items with idempotent add/remove behavior.
  • Staff fulfillment snapshots and HPOS-compatible order metadata.

short_description: Add optional products such as gift wrap, warranties, and services to WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks.
